data.title: South Garden
data.about:
South Garden is a contemporary residential complex located in the vibrant Wasl Gate area of Jebel Ali, Dubai. This development features three 12-storey residential buildings, offering studios and 1-3 bedroom apartments.

The luxurious interiors, high-quality finishes, and natural tones create a serene and elegant living environment. Residents enjoy modern amenities, including a gym, swimming pool, children's playground, and 24-hour security. South Garden at Wasl Gate Apartments in Dubai provides a perfect blend of comfort and modern aesthetics, ideal for those seeking a tranquil yet stylish lifestyle in the city.

characteristics_module.title: Enjoy Exclusive Living at South Garden!
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime Location: South Garden - in Wasl Gate by Wasl Properties is strategically located in Jebel Ali, offering seamless connectivity to major areas like Dubai Marina, Palm Jumeirah, and Dubai World Central Airport.
  • Modern Living Spaces: The complex features three 12-storey residential buildings with studios and 1-3 bedroom apartments, designed with contemporary interiors, luxurious finishes, and natural tones.
  • World-Class Amenities: Residents enjoy access to an ultra-modern gym, swimming pool, children's playground, recreation areas, and a beautiful garden.
  • Safety and Security: South Garden ensures a safe living environment with 24-hour security, video surveillance, and video intercom systems.
  • Family-Friendly Community: The development offers a peaceful yet vibrant lifestyle, perfect for families and professionals alike.
  • Flexible Payment Plans: South Garden - in Wasl Gate offers a 60/40 payment plan, making it accessible for various buyers.
  • Green Spaces: Relax in the serene garden areas, perfect for leisurely walks and family gatherings.

location_tile.title: South Garden at Wasl Gate, Dubai - Ideal Connectivity
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Positioned in the heart of Wasl Gate, South Garden offers residents seamless connectivity to Dubai’s vibrant city life while maintaining a tranquil environment. The development is a short drive from major attractions, making it convenient for both work and leisure. Whether you're headed to the bustling streets of Dubai Marina, the serene beaches of Palm Jumeirah, or the globally renowned Expo City, everything is within easy reach. Additionally, proximity to key transportation routes ensures hassle-free travel across Dubai and beyond.

  • 05 Minutes- IBN Battuta Mall
  • 05 Minutes - Sheikh Zayed Road
  • 10 Minutes - Dubai Marina
  • 20 Minutes - Al Maktoum International Airport

seo.metaTitle: South Garden at Wasl Gate, Dubai
seo.metaDescription: Explore studio to 3-bedroom apartments in South Garden at Al Wasl Gate area of Jebel Ali. Find payment plan amenities and other details.

more_info.answer: The starting price for apartments at South Garden - in Wasl Gate by Wasl Properties is AED 550,000. This offers an excellent entry point for buyers looking for luxurious and affordable living in the heart of Jebel Ali, Dubai.
more_info.question: What is the starting price of apartments at South Garden in Wasl Gate?

more_info.answer: South Garden offers a range of unit types, including cozy studios and spacious 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments. Each residence is thoughtfully designed with luxurious interiors, high-quality finishes, and a serene atmosphere.
more_info.question: What types of units are available at South Garden at Wasl Gate?

more_info.answer: South Garden offers a flexible payment plan with 60% payable during construction and 40% on handover. The payment structure includes an easy quarterly installment option of 5% per quarter, making it convenient for buyers and investors alike.
more_info.question: What is the payment plan for South Garden at Wasl Gate?

more_info.answer: Residents of South Garden enjoy a wide array of amenities, including a state-of-the-art gym, a swimming pool, a children's playground, 24-hour security, central air conditioning, and beautifully landscaped gardens. These amenities cater to both relaxation and an active lifestyle, making South Garden a perfect choice for families and professionals.
